accounts.name: base_destination_token_account
docs: Existing token account selected by the program admin to receive base surplus.

accounts.name: quote_destination_token_account
docs: Existing token account selected by the program admin to receive quote surplus.

accounts.name: market
docs: live account; otherwise callers must use the normal bookkeeping-aware close instruction.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pinned to the deployer so the first caller after a deployment cannot claim the program.
Hand it over afterwards with `nominate_program_authority` and `accept_program_authority`

accounts.name: old_interval
docs: MarketInterval account the position was registered in before it was paused
only ever written through its account data

errors.name: FlowTooSmall
errors.msg: Increase order size or reduce order duration

errors.name: NotEnoughDeposits
errors.msg: Deposits are too low for specified flow

errors.name: MinAmountOutNotReached
errors.msg: Minimum amount out is not reached

errors.name: MarketStillExists
errors.msg: Market account still exists; use the bookkeeping-aware close instruction

errors.name: WrongMarketKind
errors.msg: Instruction is not supported for this market kind

errors.name: MakerInventoryNotZero
errors.msg: Maker inventory must be settled to less than one token atom

errors.name: MakerFlowNotZero
errors.msg: Dedicated market flows must be exactly zero

errors.name: DedicatedFlowTooLarge
errors.msg: Dedicated market flow exceeds the program safety limit

errors.name: OutstandingProtocolFees
errors.msg: Protocol fees must be withdrawn before closing the market

errors.name: InvalidPayer
errors.msg: Account does not match the payer of the position

errors.name: InvalidReceiver
errors.msg: Account does not match the receiver of the position

errors.name: UnsupportedMintExtension
errors.msg: Mint carries a token extension this program does not support

errors.name: MintFreezesNewAccounts
errors.msg: Mint freezes new token accounts by default

errors.name: MarketFlowNotZero
errors.msg: Market flows must be exactly zero

fields.name: base_per_quote
docs: Defines how many base token atoms are exchanged per quote token atom
per slot multiplied by BOOKKEEPING_PRECISION_FACTOR

fields.name: previous_base_per_quote
docs: Staged snapshot, becomes the start of the average price window on the next roll

fields.name: window_base_per_quote
docs: Snapshot at the start of the average price window

fields.name: quote_per_base
docs: Defines how many quote token atoms are exchanged per base token atom
per slot multiplied by BOOKKEEPING_PRECISION_FACTOR

fields.name: previous_quote_per_base
docs: Staged snapshot, becomes the start of the average price window on the next roll

fields.name: window_quote_per_base
docs: Snapshot at the start of the average price window

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Slot when bookkeeping was last updated

fields.name: previous_update_slot
docs: Slot when previous base/quote ratio was determined

fields.name: window_start_slot
docs: Slot the average price window starts at, always at least MIN_AVERAGE_PRICE_INTERVAL
slots before last_update_slot

fields.name: slots_without_trade
docs: Slots without trades since market start and last_update_slot

fields.name: market
docs: Canonical market address. Market ids are namespaced for dedicated makers.

fields.name: authority
docs: Creator of this position who can close it

fields.name: market
docs: Corresponding market address

fields.name: base_balance
docs: Base balance at last update slot with bookkeeping precision

fields.name: quote_balance
docs: Quote balance at last update slot with bookkeeping precision

fields.name: base_per_quote_snapshot
docs: Bookkeeping snapshot at last update slot

fields.name: quote_per_base_snapshot
docs: Bookkeeping snapshot at last update slot

fields.name: base_flow_atoms
docs: Base flow, no extra flow precision needed, since flow are set manually

fields.name: quote_flow_atoms
docs: Quote flow, no extra flow precision needed, since flow are set manually

fields.name: base_debt
docs: Base debt, can arise if position is not liquidated in time

fields.name: quote_debt
docs: Quote debt, can arise if position is not liquidated in time

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: Slot when position was last updated

fields.name: slots_without_trade_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of slots without trades in this market when this order was created

types.name: Market
docs: Both market initializers enforce the canonical mint-pair/id PDA and store its bump.
Existing-account contexts rely on Anchor's owner/discriminator checks and these immutable
seed fields instead of deriving the address again. New creation or migration paths must
preserve this invariant; downstream account linkage and vault CPI signer seeds still apply.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Immutable ordered mint pair used in the market PDA seeds.

fields.name: base_flow
docs: Current aggregate flow of base token.

fields.name: quote_flow
docs: Current aggregate flow of quote token.

fields.name: minimum_base_deposit_atoms
docs: Minimum base trade amount.

fields.name: minimum_quote_deposit_atoms
docs: Minimum quote trade amount.

fields.name: start_slot
docs: Slot at which market is active.

fields.name: open_positions
docs: Number of open trade and ordinary liquidity positions in this market.

fields.name: accumulated_base_fees
docs: Protocol fees accumulated and not yet withdrawn.

fields.name: id
docs: Immutable market id, scoped to the ordered base/quote mint pair across both market kinds.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Trading fee in basis points.

fields.name: unhealthy_liquidity_fee_bps
docs: Penalty fee for unhealthy ordinary liquidity positions.

fields.name: slots_until_debt
docs: Slots of net outflow an ordinary liquidity position must cover to count as healthy.

fields.name: liquidity_amplification
docs: Ordinary liquidity amplification and withdrawal holdback factor.

fields.name: kind
docs: One of `MARKET_KIND_*`.

fields.name: is_paused
docs: One means new position admission/resumption is paused. Dedicated markets use maker control.

fields.name: bump
docs: Immutable canonical PDA bump, also used to sign vault transfers.

fields.name: maker_authority
docs: Economic owner. Only this key may fund, withdraw, or change authorities.

fields.name: pending_maker_authority
docs: Two-step ownership transfer nominee; the default address means no pending nomination.

fields.name: quote_operator
docs: Hot key allowed to update the dedicated quote flows.

fields.name: maker_base_inventory
docs: Signed net maker inventory in bookkeeping precision. Negative values are maker debt.

fields.name: maker_base_flow_atoms
docs: Dedicated maker's configured flows in token atoms per slot.

fields.name: maker_base_per_quote_snapshot
docs: Lazy-accounting snapshots for the single dedicated maker.

fields.name: bookkeeping
docs: Cumulative prices, inactive slots, and average-price windows for this market.

fields.name: market
docs: Market this account belongs to

fields.name: index
docs: Reference interval this account covers

fields.name: payer
docs: Address which funded this account, used to determine where the rent goes if account is closed

fields.name: slots_without_trades_snapshot
docs: Takes a snapshot of market bookkeeping for given slot

fields.name: open_positions
docs: Trade positions referencing this interval, including paused positions awaiting resume or close

fields.name: base_exits
docs: Stores the base flow that is removed from the market at a given slot because an order ended

fields.name: quote_exits
docs: Stores the quote flow that is removed from the market at a given slot because an order ended

fields.name: base_per_quote_snapshot
docs: Takes a snapshot of market bookkeeping for given slot

fields.name: quote_per_base_snapshot
docs: Takes a snapshot of market bookkeeping for given slot

fields.name: market
docs: Canonical market address. Market ids are namespaced for dedicated makers.

fields.name: authority
docs: The authority can call admin instruction

fields.name: pending_authority_slot
docs: Slot at which nomination was made; cleared to zero when no authority is pending.

fields.name: authority_transfer_delay_slots
docs: Required cooldown before accept

fields.name: dedicated_maker_fee_share_bps
docs: Share of realized dedicated-market trading fees credited to the maker, in basis points of
the fee itself. The program authority may update this globally.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Two-step transfer nominee. The default address means no nomination is pending.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields

types.name: Side
docs: Direction of a trade position.

types.name: TradeFeeCollectedEvent
docs: Emitted every time a trading fee is actually realized. This is intentionally separate from
`ClosePositionEvent`: repeated partial withdrawals round fees independently, so a one-shot
total cannot always reconcile the maker and protocol ledgers.

fields.name: authority
docs: Creator of this position, can change operator and receiver and everything what operator can do

fields.name: market
docs: Corresponding market address

fields.name: payer
docs: Payer of rent

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator can pause and continue this position

fields.name: base_receiver
docs: Receives base token

fields.name: quote_receiver
docs: Receives quote token

fields.name: flow
docs: Trade amount per slot with FLOW_PRECISION

fields.name: bookkeeping_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of base_per_quote for buy order or quote_per_base for sell orders when this order was created

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount to spend

fields.name: inactive_refund
docs: Refund due to no trades happening because there was no opposite trade side

fields.name: start_slot
docs: The slot when this position starts trading

fields.name: last_update_slot
docs: The slot when this position starts trading, updated when position is paused and continued

fields.name: swapped_amount_at_snapshot
docs: Amount that has been swapped so far until latest snapshots

fields.name: withdrawn_amount
docs: Swapped amount that has been withdrawn so far

fields.name: remaining_slots
docs: Remaining slots of trading from last_update_slot

fields.name: slots_without_trades_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of slots without trades in this market when this order was created

fields.name: id
docs: Position id

fields.name: fee_bps_at_submission
docs: Trading fee at submission, retained through pauses, withdrawals, and final settlement.

fields.name: side
docs: Whether this position buys or sells the base token
